intent: Write product descriptions for 10 handmade soap scents and an SEO meta description for each.

spec.goal: Get a product description and an SEO meta description for each of 10 handmade soap scents.
spec.deliverable: A written copy document with 10 handmade soap scents, each with a product description and an SEO meta description.
constraints: Each scent gets both a product description and its own SEO meta description.
The scents are not named in the request, so the agents should not assume particular brand details beyond the soaps being handmade.
Meta descriptions should be written for search engine results, so they should be concise.
done_criteria: There are 10 distinct soap scents, each clearly labelled.
Every scent has a product description.
Every scent has its own SEO meta description.
Each product description presents the soap as handmade.
Meta descriptions are short enough to display in search results.
spec.summary: You want product descriptions for 10 handmade soap scents, each paired with its own SEO meta description.
